source.note: The SPACE before the second class separator is rejected; independent fixtures cover the adjacent and doubled forms.

error.name: Error
error.message:
Parse error on line 3:
...s A hot;class A cold ;class A other;;B
-----------------------^
Expecting 'COMMENT', 'SEMI', 'NEWLINE', 'EOF', 'AMP', 'COLON', 'DOWN', 'DEFAULT', 'NUM', 'COMMA', 'NODE_STRING', 'BRKT', 'MINUS', 'MULT', 'UNICODE_TEXT', got 'SPACE'
